rationale: A unanimous, text-forward resolution makes the Chief Justice the modal assignee/author, with Thomas and Kagan as the most plausible alternatives given their central statutory and Fry-framing roles in conference. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch (textualism and anti-circumvention caveats) to emphasize limits, while the rest have weaker incentives in a narrow 9-0 opinion.
